title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（吉田啓史郎研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Yoshida Keishiro)
educationalGoal:
Based on the fundamental knowledge of aeronautics and astronautics and the fundamental skills for designing and manufacturing aircrafts/spacecrafts and their components, students will develop their ability to design actual aircrafts/spacecrafts and their components.
Students will conduct numerical simulations and/or experiments on mechanical properties of aerospace composite structures.
advice:
The Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics aims to educate students to become engineers who can support the development of transportation machines such as aircrafts and spacecrafts by using their knowledge of aeronautics/astronautics and their skills on mechanical design and manufacturing. Design Project III is a culmination subject in the final stage of the curriculum.
The targets of this subject are the following:
-to develop the ability to design actual aircrafts/spacecrafts and their components
-to develop the ability to apply theories in aeronautics and astronautics to solve real technical problems of aircraft and spacecraft
-to develop the ability to evaluate the phenomena that occur in real aircraft and spacecraft based on aeronautics and astronautics

In this laboratory, students conduct research on technical issues on composite materials used for aerospace structures. A detailed project theme is decided through discussion with the supervisor. Students will discover their own problems and solve them. Students must also understand the targets of this subject and the content of this course based on the syllabus.
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Because Design Project III is based on lectures, experiments, and practice of quarters 1-6 in the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics, students must review them appropriately as needed.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)Students clearly understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose.
(2)Students prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it with related discussion. Students prepare their research results as a final report and present it with related discussion in an open presentation and evaluation meeting.
(3)For problems on aircraft structure design, students can realize a solution by making full use of design tools such as 3D-CAD and structural analysis software.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)Students clearly understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose.
(2)Students should prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it. Students prepare their research results as a final report and present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting.
(3)For problems on aircraft structure design, students can examine a solution by using design tools such as 3D-CAD and structural analysis software with instruction.

lessons.content:
Course orientation
Students learn engineering design process that
includes establishing a project theme,
summarizing their activities in document, and
making oral presentation on their activities.
Students self-check on their activities based on
the discussion at laboratory weekly meeting
and at interim and final presentation meetings
held by department of aeronautics.
